newsitem.title: USA: US corporate bonds off with Treasuries, eye supply.
newsitem.headline: US corporate bonds off with Treasuries, eye supply.

text.p: U.S. corporate bonds traded off at midday tracking U.S. Treasuries lower while most actiivity was centered on the supply of new issues, dealers said.
"The new issue calendar is heating up and secondary activity continues to center on primary activity," said one high-grade trader.
Overall activity, however, remained relatively quiet with spreads to U.S. Tressuries seen unchanged, traders said.
Among new secondary issues, Citicorp's 7.25 percent bonds were seen bid at 78 basis points over U.S. Treasuries.
